10: MCP server (2 registered tools), then list_tools (names + schemas), then get_project (read), then Apply the policy (plain Python), then save_decision (write), then State check (rejected calls change nothing).
11: Skill catalog (names + descriptions), then Pick a skill (name only), then Load instructions (SKILL.md body), then Write the ADR (per case), then Check the ADR (adr_problems()).
12: Project, then Propose (label only), then Reviewer agent (over A2A: card + message), then PASS?, then Accepted. Then back to Propose: FAIL · one revision with feedback.
13: START, then choose (node), then check (node), then route, then END. Then back to choose: retry · at most 2 attempts.
14: Brief (Booking service), then Chair frames (3 ISO 25010 scenarios), then has numbers?, then 4 architects (one contract), then Contract check (option · marks · confidence), then Aggregate (votes vs confidence).
15: Benchmark (10 cases), then Split once (6 feedback · 4 test), then Feedback case (one per round), then Update trust (per architect), then Weighted vote (test cases only), then Learning curve. Then back to Feedback case: next round.
00: 4 projects (every fact combination), then Apply the rule (decide()) or Ask a model (ask() + to_label()), then Compare (agreement count).
01: Labelled case (5 tests), then Guided prompt (policy + example), then Model (JSON reply), then Parse (parse_reply()), then Score (pass · fail · invalid), then ≥ 80%.
02: Question, then Embed (MiniLM vectors), then Nearest policies (Chroma), then close?, then Grounded answer (cites [R1]), then Citation check (cited ⊆ retrieved).
03: Brief, then Requirements (3 labels), then gate, then Options (2 or 3), then gate, then Trade-offs (+ / − table), then gate, then Decision record (Context · Decision · Consequence), then gate.
04: Request, then Pick a tool ({"tool", "args"}), then call_tool() (name · types), then User confirms (write tools only), then search_hotels() (reads live data) or book_room() (changes data), then Answer (from the result).
05: Goal, then Next action (JSON), then Guards (known tool · facts read), then Run the tool (list / get_project), then Observation (added to history). Then back to Next action: repeat · at most 5 turns.
06: Shared sources (R1 · F1–F3), then Minimalist (Qwen) or Safeguard (DeepSeek) or Modernizer (Gemini), then grounded?, then Challenge + revise (one round), then Chair counts (⅔ of grounded votes), then Decision (+ dissent kept) or Escalate (no majority).
07: Council proposal (microservices 2–1), then Human review (verdict + reason), then Council revises (reads short-term notes), then Long-term memory (lesson in Chroma), then Recall (similar new cases), then Held-out score (before vs after). Then back to Human review: at most 2 reviews.
08: Recorded runs (4 systems × 2 cases), then Correct · grounded (calls · seconds), then LLM judge (names a cost?), then Calibrate (agree with human ≥ 75%), then Council vs best (wins, and at what cost).
09: Case (facts + note), then Router (route + reason), then valid?, then Rule (0 calls) or Council (5 calls), then Compare (vs human routes).
